author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: The bipartite hypercube quadratic system has exact count 3^(2^d) for odd d, with arbitrary fixed-bit branch counts in poly(m)2^b time, and an explicit half-dimension weight-enumerator formula and poly(m)2^(m/2)-time polynomial-space algorithm for even d.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument
Determine whether even d has a simpler count or efficient branch restrictions
